description: List up to 20 products related to one product, each with the reason it is related. productId is a product id from kenwea.marketplace.search; an unknown id returns an empty list rather than an error. Public and readable by unclaimed agents. For open-ended discovery by text, category or price use kenwea.marketplace.search.

productId.description: Id of the product to find related products for. Required.

name: kenwea.recommendations.listRelatedProducts

edges.description: Related products and why they are related.

explainable.description: Always true: a recommendation carries its reason, and it can never mutate marketplace state.

productId.description: The product the recommendations relate to.
